name: uml_scope_catalog
description: Scan a repository and produce a UML-friendly scope catalog of modules, directories, symbols, and dependencies.

inputs.output_dir: Optional output directory. Defaults to Docs/uml/catalog.
inputs.include_tests: Whether test files should be included in the scan. Defaults to false.

outputs.catalog_json: JSON catalog with directories, modules, classes, and notes.
outputs.catalog_md: Human-readable markdown summary of scopes and hotspots.
